description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of data across six distinct categories, labeled numerically from 0 to 5 around the perimeter. Each slice corresponds to a category and is labeled with its percentage, absolute count, and a number identifier. The largest segment, colored light blue, represents category 2 with 22.4% (6583). The second largest, also light blue, is category 0 at 13.3% (3910). Category 1, in a pale yellow, accounts for 13.8% (4046). Category 5, a lighter blue, makes up 10.4% (3043). Category 4, a very light blue, is 6.2% (1810). The smallest segment, a pale green, corresponds to category 3 at 6.8% (2002). The chart includes percentage and count labels within each slice, and the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the bottom left and moving clockwise. There is no legend or exploded slices, and a grey bar is present at the top, outside the pie chart itself.
